status: Version-1.6-retained Scopus/IEEE request contract: complete A1/A2/A3, corrected finite IEEE T2 and finite V1/O1, common 2026-08-10 cutoff, plus empirically validated terminal/zero-page conventions; final execution requires clean authorized storage

credential_and_pilot_policy.credentials_cookies_tokens: Never serialize credentials, cookies, tokens, authorization headers, or IEEE userInfo. Supply Scopus authentication only in an in-memory X-ELS-APIKey request header from a secure runtime environment.
credential_and_pilot_policy.private_artifacts: Raw responses, page-ID/rank reconciliation, normalized pilot outputs, and pilot merge products must be written only under a Git-ignored owner-only directory (0700 directories; 0600 files).
credential_and_pilot_policy.pilot_records: Pilot records must not enter candidate screening, a candidate corpus, deduplication for the review, retained evidence, or synthesis. A final run requires separate authorization and a clean output directory.

driver_controls.validated_ordering: The driver rejects nonvalidated sort values: Scopus must use eid and IEEE must use newest.
driver_controls.clean_output_requirement: The driver refuses a non-empty output directory so attempts cannot be mixed or overwritten.
driver_controls.private_output_enforcement: On POSIX the driver creates/chmods artifact directories to 0700 and atomic JSON files to 0600.
driver_controls.response_scrubbing: Drops normalized secret/context keys and redacts sensitive URL/session material before persistence, including authority userinfo, encoded/nested context, and values that cannot be safely parsed; benign query components are retained.
driver_controls.ieee_type_filter_option: The historical pilot used ContentType facets. The authorized final strategy has no content-type filter: invoke --ieee-no-content-type-filter so the request retains only explicit non-type refinements.
driver_controls.terminal_page_conventions: Scopus may advertise the actual count on a one-page terminal result; accept only requested page size or the exactly computed terminal count. IEEE may report totalPages=1 for a valid zero result; fetch and reconcile one empty page. Both conventions still require two identical passes and retrieved == source total.

common_execution_contract.retry_delay: Honor parseable Retry-After; otherwise exponential 1, 2, 4 seconds; cap every wait at 60 seconds.
common_execution_contract.total_change_rule: If the source-reported total differs on any page or between complete verification passes, invalidate the entire snapshot, do not normalize or merge it, and restart from page one once. A second total change is a logged terminal source failure; run-metadata is marked failure and no execution-summary is emitted.
common_execution_contract.ordered_reconciliation: Require a stable source ID on every returned record, preserve source response position as global rank 1..source_total, reject repeated page-ID sequences and duplicate IDs, reject unexpected start/offset, short/nonterminal pages, or missing pages, and require a second complete pass with exactly the same ordered ID list.
common_execution_contract.success_rule: A logical query succeeds only when pages_retrieved equals computed expected pages, unique source IDs equals retrieved records, retrieved records equals source total, and the two ordered passes are identical. Any other condition is a failure, never a partial result.
